texts.zh:
来自先前派遣去调查[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]的最新的汇报令人高度关注。显然这些的外星舰船打开了炮口做出了一些令人不适的近距离掠飞。与此同时，他们向我们送来了一份由他们的一个个体发出的讯息——应该是一位某领域的领袖，我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]猜测——用他们的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]做出应为侵犯性的手势，至少我们如此理解……

一些观察者怀疑，他们有可能出于某种目的正在试图蓄意制造事故。然而其他人指出他们并未做出任何实质性的敌对举动，并敦促我们在弄明白他们的意图之前不要过早地下定结论。
texts.en:
The latest reports from [This.Leader.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] sent to investigate the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], are highly concerning. Apparently the alien ships have made several uncomfortably close passes of our ships with gunports open. All the while, they have also been sending us a transmission of one of their individuals - a leader of some sort, our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] hypothesize - making gestures with their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] that seem rather aggressive, to us at least...

Some observers suspect that they may be attempting to deliberately provoke an incident for reasons unknown. Others, however, point out that they have yet to make any outright hostile moves, and urge us not to jump to conclusions before we know more of their intentions.

texts.zh:
来自先前派遣去调查[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]的最新的汇报令人高度关注。显然这些的外星舰船打开了炮口做出了一些令人不适的近距离掠飞。与此同时，他们向我们送来了一份由他们的一个个体发出的讯息——应该是一位某领域的领袖，我们只能猜测——用他们的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]做出奇怪的手势，似乎表明了制造伤害的意图……

我们确定他们为是否在试图蓄意制造事故，若如此他们为何并未做出任何实质性的敌对举动。
texts.en:
The latest reports from [This.Leader.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] sent to investigate the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], are highly concerning. Apparently the alien ships have made several uncomfortably close passes of our ships with gunports open. All the while, they have also been sending us a transmission of one of their individuals - a leader of some sort, we can only assume - making odd gestures with their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] that would seem intent on causing harm...

We are unsure whether they intend to provoke an incident, and if so, why they haven't made any outright hostile moves yet.

label.en: Mimic their greeting back to them.

texts.zh:
伴随着他们的船从我们的船后撤到更安全的距离，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]对我们传送的回应只有一行字。[This.Owner.GetLinguists]努力地翻译着这封电文，最终确定了他们说的是：“ 好吧，外星人，但这只是个开始”。

看来，这次奇特的交流导致了[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]（我们现在知道他们叫这个）将我们视为宿敌，至少是潜在的宿敌。我们只能认为，他们已经在准备与我们[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]开战的可能性了。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] response to our transmission ran one line long, and was accompanied by their vessel pulling back from ours to a safer distance. Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] struggled long and hard to translate the missive, finally settling on the wording "Well sparred, alien, but this is just the beginning".

It appears that this curious exchange has resulted in the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] (as we now know them to be properly called) seeing us as rivals, or at least potential rivals. We can only assume that they are already preparing for the possibility of war with our [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName].

label.zh: 我们应该对其有所准备。
label.en: We shall be ready for them.

label.zh: 我们应该对其有所准备。
label.en: We shall be ready for them.

label.zh: 这就是表现出侵略的危险……
label.en: Such are the dangers of showing aggression...
Pacifist
Ending: sparring partners

note.zh: 获得10年的“战士被承认/被默认（二）”修正，对方给予“竞争对手”好感。

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]用一封长长的简讯回应我们的传送，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]花了一些时间来翻译。随着我们对外星人语言的理解不断加深，很明显，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]（我们现在知道他们叫这个）对我们的 "光荣姿态 "发出了非常花哨的赞赏，把我们当作朋友来问候。

看来，这种奇特的交流在他们眼里证明了我们的勇气，让他们相信我们是星系舞台上值得信赖的伙伴。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] responded to our transmission with a lengthy missive, which took our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] some time to translate. As our understanding of the aliens' language grew, it became clear that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] (as we now know them to be properly called) sent us a very flowery appreciation of our "honorable gesture", greeting us as friends.

It appears that this curious exchange has proven our mettle in their view, and convinced them that we are worthy partners on the galactic stage.

label.en: The beginnings of a beautiful friendship...
The beginnings of a beautiful friendship...
Pacifist
Xenophobe
So long as they leave us alone...
Xenophobe
That was not our intention...
Pacifist
Ending: a showing of valor

note.zh: 获得10年战士修正；对方给予“赢得尊重”好感。

texts.zh:
过了一会儿，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的热烈气氛逐渐平静下来。我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]渐渐能够理解这些信号，最终能够确定他们是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，并对他们古怪的行为作出解释。

事实证明，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一个好战的物种，他们最看重他们所说的“战士精神”。由于表现不当，我们在他们眼中显得非常低级——像是懦夫。看来这个臭名声我们还得背负一段时间……
texts.en:
After a while, the enthusiasm of displays by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] vessel declined. Over time, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] grew better at understanding their signals, eventually identifying them as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and presenting an interpretation of their odd behavior.

It turns out that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a warlike species who value above all else what they call the "warrior spirit". By failing to respond appropriately, we displayed ourselves to be of lesser worth - cowards, in essence. It seems this reputation will take quite a while to live down...

label.en: This will not do!
This will not do!
Militarist
It matters not.
Militarist
Ending: the appearance of cowardliness

texts.zh:
过了一会儿，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的热烈气氛逐渐平静下来。我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]渐渐能够理解这些信号，最终能够确定他们是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，并对他们古怪的行为作出解释。

事实证明，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一个好战的物种，他们最看重他们所说的“战士精神”。正确的应对方式是做出类似的回应。然而，他们似乎足够宽宏大量，以至于接受了我们对此的无知，甚至开始认可我们面对威胁时的冷静。
texts.en:
After a while, the enthusiasm of displays by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] vessel declined. Over time, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] grew better at understanding their signals, eventually identifying them as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and presenting an interpretation of their odd behavior.

It turns out that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a warlike species who value above all else what they call the "warrior spirit". The correct response would have been to make a similar gesture back. However, it seems they are magnanimous enough to accept that we could not have known this, and have even come to value our level-headedness in the face of what seemed like a threat.

label.zh: 很好，把他们的影像接过来！
label.en: Very good. Bring them on screen!

label.en: Fools. They will not survive us!
Ending: level-headedness

summary.text:
# 明显的敌意 / Apparent Hostility
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 首次接触阶段链 first-contact stage chain（首个事件「明显的敌意」first_contact.400）
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_events.txt:6137–6432` · `common/first_contact/00_first_contact.txt:529–565, 1857–1972`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（c7b-society）

## 如何开始 How it starts

第二阶段抽取，权重 5；仅当对方是好战或“荣誉战士”AI 时才可能出现，对方对我方已敌对则为0，本方已有此链标记则为0；对方为荣誉战士/狂热净化者 ×3（`common/first_contact/00_first_contact.txt:530–565`）。/ Stage-2 weight 5; only possible with a militarist or honorbound-warriors contact, zero if the contact is already hostile to us or the owner already had the chain; ×3 for honorbound or fanatic purifiers.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. **明显的敌意（400）**：对方舰船近距离掠过并打开炮门。/ Alien ships make threatening close passes with gunports open.
   - A 模仿他们的问候 → 90% 表面敌意收尾阶段（难度5）→ 405 或 406；10% 战斗（500，见“恐怖噪音”篇）。/ Mimic → usually the end stage → 405/406; rarely a fight (500).
   - B 无视 → 无行动收尾阶段（对方主动5 / 谨慎7）→ 410 或 411。/ Ignore → no-action end stage → 410/411.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 405 陪练伙伴 / 406 勇气的展示：互斥，权重各 1。/ exclusive.
- 410 显得懦弱 / 411 冷静的表现：互斥，权重各 1。/ exclusive.
- 所有收尾选项都调用 finish_first_contact_effect（建立正式通讯，之后按帝国类型转入后续事件，如反向接触、教程、商队等），并调用 first_contact_inform_intel。 / Every ending option calls finish_first_contact_effect (opens regular communications, then routes to follow-ups such as reverse first contact, tutorial, caravaneer events) and first_contact_inform_intel.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

400 对格式塔有单独文本；各结局选项文字随本方军国、和平、排外、灭绝倾向变化。/ 400 has gestalt text; option text varies with militarist, pacifist, xenophobe and homicidal ethics.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：400–411 与 500 的调用、default_apparent_hostility_* 四个阶段、第二阶段条目。
- 审阅改动 Changes：原 405 篇只含 405/406；现并入 400、410、411 并连接阶段。/ The old story held only 405/406; 400, 410 and 411 are now included with stage bridges. 500/505 are kept in the Monstrous Noises story (shared helper).
